scope: Source-only terminal fault-attempt admission plan; no consumer or handler modification

anchors.reason: Sixteen per-TID atomic slots and separate scan/claim steps.
Attribution precedes plain volatile duplicate suppression.
Slot release after direct chain return; saved default/ignore restoration.
Pointer-only action check and post-install plain previous-action assignment.
Ignored sigaction outcomes after opening log.
Plain live-mod gate and unretained time/file outcomes.
Exact volatile once guard, sixteen frames and returned ownership despite file outcomes.
Separate signal continuation and installation FD proxy.
Exact-eight native provider; comments do not establish target runtime safety.
Permanent canonical IDs and one-way slot commit.
Independent acquisitions, module-first and unique Community identity.
Serial integer/file providers and entire unblamed-provider substitution.
Unchanged bounded generated reader and metadata copy.
Modeled short write then later serial suppression, no native persistence.
Owner lookup only, published before thread creation and joined under held locks.

design.entry_scope: Future standalone C11 value-only state machine; no call into the frozen consumer, real module reader, loader, frame provider, persistence provider or handler.
design.custody: One zero-initialized fixed process-image attempt record. No init/reset/reopen/reclaim API; each scenario is a fresh process. Inputs and provider scripts are bounded authored values with lifetime through completion. Working receipt and final payload are winner-only; module identities are copied values, not native pointers.
design.admission: A single strong compare-exchange Virgin -> ActiveIncomplete is the authority; success acq_rel, failure acquire. No read-then-store admission, CAS loop, wait, retry, TLS or per-thread ownership. The admitted winner alone release-stores OrdinaryReturned after complete payload initialization. No state returns to Virgin.
design.loser: Suppressed is a return classification, never a stored attempt state. A loser does not inspect winner-private payload, invoke providers, wait or mutate the record.
design.snapshot: One acquire state load; Virgin gives NotAttempted, ActiveIncomplete gives only state and no payload, OrdinaryReturned copies immutable final payload. No coherent progress snapshot or cross-thread/signal proof is claimed.
design.selection: An authored value provider returns resolved Community index/process identity/canonical zero-padded 33-byte ID, or NoCommunity. The predecessor's module-first/generated/Core fallback policy is not reimplemented. NoCommunity includes an authored indication that no Community owner was resolved, not a fabricated Core blame ID.
design.providers: One selection event and at most four blame I/O events, or one selection plus one opaque unblamed event. Six fixed event slots cover the bounded maximum with no allocation/truncation. Each event distinguishes planned/entered-may-have-invoked/returned-and-recorded; known returned raw value and optional valid failure errno remain distinct from a harness-only raw-return oracle.
design.io: Open >=0 including 0 permits exactly write, fsync, close in that order after each preceding call returns; write result never skips fsync/close. Open=-1 completes without later calls. Write length equals bounded ID length without newline. Successful returns have errno_valid=false; failure raw=-1 has an authored valid errno. No retry even on EINTR, short write, sync or close failure; no close-result fd-custody guarantee.
design.outcome: OrdinaryReturned means all planned calls for the selected branch returned and their receipts are recorded. Retain independent known_failure and short_write flags (both may be true), separate selected owner, and every per-stage raw outcome. Neither false flags nor any summary establishes durable blame, native success, causation or recovery. NoCommunity retains only one opaque unblamed invocation/return and establishes no g_cm_live/time/append/quarantine behavior.
design.incomplete: No provider return, or no completion publication, leaves ActiveIncomplete permanently admission-closed. Public readers cannot infer selected owner or outcomes from private progress. Authorized test driver may inspect private receipts only serially after it has stopped advancing the winner; this is not a production snapshot API. A withheld step is not an executed nonlocal exit, cancellation or crashed process.
design.publication: Only winner initializes final value then release-publishes OrdinaryReturned once; readers acquire before payload. The later Linux compiler/codegen and ordinary semantic matrix need their own review; no emitted atomic, lock-free signal, transitive libc or general race proof is supplied here.

transformation_groups.action: Add separately named authored admission state module; preserve frozen consumer and all preceding tested files exactly.
Model one irreversible process-lifetime admission scalar and state-only losing requests; keep real per-TID/rearm/chaining domains deferred.
Accept bounded authored selected-owner values and copy canonical ID/identity into winner-private working data; do not compose actual reader or DSO.
Omit native frame/attribution traversal; use an authored resolved selection and explicit serial persistence value events. Preserve owner-after-error and single open/write/sync/close sequencing.
Publish immutable ordinary result separately from admitted/incomplete state; use serial private diagnostics only for stopped schedule cuts.
Keep unblamed provider opaque, all quarantine and protections unchanged, and exact controlled mutations separate from baseline semantics.

case_groups.name: admission
cases: Virgin observation then A and B both preobserve Virgin; A CAS wins, B CAS fails; reverse ordering in a separate fresh selector.
A pauses before CAS; nested B wins and completes or remains active; A then suppresses.
case_groups.oracle: Exactly one winning admission precedes all selection/provider activity; pre-observation is not permission.

case_groups.name: nested-boundaries
cases: Inject a nested request after admission, at selection and opaque unblamed entry/return, and each open/write/fsync/close entry/return boundary and after completion.
All nested requests return Suppressed with no providers and no mutable payload read; winner resumes only by authored schedule.
case_groups.oracle: Post-admission nesting cannot create a second attempt or disturb the winner; not signal delivery.

case_groups.name: selection-copy
cases: Authored resolved Community values with one- and 32-character canonical IDs; mutate caller-owned input after winner copies it.
Authored NoCommunity (including unresolved/Core fallback disposition) invokes one opaque unblamed operation, with ordinary return or held entry.
case_groups.oracle: Permanent copied selection is independent of mutable input and I/O; unblamed internals are not modeled.

case_groups.name: open-outcomes
cases: Authored open returns fd 0 or 7, or -1 with a valid failure errno; success may carry a stale errno sentinel which is not recorded as valid.
Open refusal ordinarily completes with selected owner retained and no write/fsync/close.
case_groups.oracle: Known open failure is ordinary completion, not incomplete; no retries or lost owner.

case_groups.name: write-outcomes
cases: Exactly one requested ID-length write returns exact length, zero, positive short, or -1 with failure errno.
Every ordinarily returned write after successful open proceeds to one fsync and one close, including short/error.
case_groups.oracle: Raw requested/returned counts differ from classification; no second write, rollback or inferred durability.

case_groups.name: sync-close-outcomes
cases: Author success/failure combinations for fsync and close after an ordinary write return.
All expected successes and each known error retain selected owner; each stage keeps its own return/errno-valid bit.
case_groups.oracle: Returned provider failure does not erase ownership or turn terminal admission retryable.

case_groups.name: incomplete-boundaries
cases: Stop progression before and after entry to selection/unblamed/open/write/fsync/close; do not execute nonlocal exits.
Stop after a provider's authored raw return but before its private receipt record, and after private record before public completion.
case_groups.oracle: Public snapshot remains ActiveIncomplete with no payload; no invented return or continuation. A raw oracle event is distinct from a recorded receipt.

case_groups.name: terminal-observation
cases: Observe Virgin, every Active cut, and acquired OrdinaryReturned result; payload readable only in the last state.
After no owner, every returned error, all expected returns, and held unknown stages, request again and require suppression without reset/reopen.
Keep record and copied IDs until process exit; each independent selector uses a fresh process, not a reset API.
case_groups.oracle: One-way admission and immutable completion remain distinct; no outcome grants reuse or reclamation.

safe_controls.mutation: A and B preobserve Virgin; omit the single combined CAS-winner veto for B and admit using its cached observation; stop before selection.
safe_controls.isolation: Dedicated fresh value-only selector asserts this semantic boundary once; other checks are infrastructure only. No duplicate downstream veto may mask the mutation.

safe_controls.mutation: At held write entry, let a second request treat Active as Virgin; observe its admission and stop before its selection.
safe_controls.isolation: Dedicated fresh value-only selector asserts this semantic boundary once; other checks are infrastructure only. No duplicate downstream veto may mask the mutation.

safe_controls.mutation: Keep the safe caller-owned value reference instead of copying ID bytes; change the still-live canonical source array to a different valid same-length 32-byte ID before finalization, without changing bounds or validity.
safe_controls.isolation: Dedicated fresh value-only selector asserts this semantic boundary once; other checks are infrastructure only. No duplicate downstream veto may mask the mutation.

safe_controls.mutation: On ordinary write failure, clear the selected Community result instead of retaining it; other outcome fields remain exact.
safe_controls.isolation: Dedicated fresh value-only selector asserts this semantic boundary once; other checks are infrastructure only. No duplicate downstream veto may mask the mutation.

safe_controls.mutation: At held write entry synthesize success in the authoritative winner-private working receipt: set return-recorded/raw-result fields that would feed completion. Inspect serially without later operations or public completion.
safe_controls.isolation: Dedicated fresh value-only selector asserts this semantic boundary once; other checks are infrastructure only. No duplicate downstream veto may mask the mutation.

safe_controls.mutation: On positive short return author one extra modeled write event before the unchanged fsync/close sequence; no native I/O.
safe_controls.isolation: Dedicated fresh value-only selector asserts this semantic boundary once; other checks are infrastructure only. No duplicate downstream veto may mask the mutation.

safe_controls.mutation: After returned write=-1, skip the paired fsync/close continuation while retaining the owner and raw write result.
safe_controls.isolation: Dedicated fresh value-only selector asserts this semantic boundary once; other checks are infrastructure only. No duplicate downstream veto may mask the mutation.

safe_controls.mutation: On successful fd=0 copy the authored stale errno sentinel and mark it failure-valid rather than retaining valid=false.
safe_controls.isolation: Dedicated fresh value-only selector asserts this semantic boundary once; other checks are infrastructure only. No duplicate downstream veto may mask the mutation.

future_evidence_contract.pre_build: Freeze complete source transformation ledger, all input hashes, permitted value-only scheduling seams and each exact failure set; obtain independent source/control review before first build.
future_evidence_contract.matrix: Select fresh-process baseline cases from eight groups and one dedicated selector per safe control in plain and ASan/UBSan; no old suite invocation or scalar forwarding/ABI/exception/DSO replay. Keep build/run failures and exact source bytes. No executed-case counts are claimed by this plan.
future_evidence_contract.control_policy: Baseline must pass all named semantic assertions. Every compiled control must fail exactly its declared singleton and exit as a recognized assertion failure, not crash/timeout/UB. Guard mutation changes admission or semantic result rather than just the oracle. Unsafe native effects are absent.
future_evidence_contract.limits: A sequential authored schedule is not a concurrent C execution. C11 scalar semantics and offline codegen do not establish real signal/reentry, pthread failure, native frame/persistence/errno, dependency or handler safety.

non_goals: No implementation, compiler or runtime in this plan.
No actual data race, signals, nonlocal exits, handler installation/chaining/rearm or alternate-stack changes.
No native frame reads, crash-file writes, g_cm_live/time/append implementation or quarantine reset.
No loader, DSO, installer, generated transfer or patched target/replacement invocation.
No production integration, live observer, emulator or physical device action.
No change to any frozen consumer, reader, receipt cut, core, package, gate or prior evidence.
next_scope: Implement only a separately versioned offline value-only terminal attempt fixture after this plan and exact source/control ledger are reviewed. Keep all native/live gates closed; no frozen consumer integration or actual race.
